ios.desc:
Ever wondered how accurate your weather forecast actually is? VeriSky lets you find out, and pick the model that works best for you.

Most weather apps choose a model for you, or quietly blend a few. But no single model wins everywhere. The one that nails temperature in your city might be hopeless at wind, or great for tomorrow yet useless a week out, and the best model can differ between towns just miles apart.

VeriSky scores how each model has actually performed at your exact location over the past days, weeks, and months, separately for temperature, rain, wind, and sun. It also shows how far ahead each stays reliable, so you know which to trust short-term and which for the long haul.

Switch between the top global models, all free:

- ECMWF IFS: the gold standard in global forecasting
- ECMWF AIFS: ECMWF's new AI-powered model
- GFS: NOAA's widely-used American model
- AIGFS: NOAA's new AI-powered model
- ICON: Germany's DWD high-resolution model

Show several at once to see where they agree, or blend them into one confidence score for every hour and day.

Time travel: drag back up to 7 days to see what a model predicted on earlier days, laid over what actually happened. One glance tells you how much to trust tomorrow's forecast.

Plus charts for temperature, sunshine, UV, precipitation (rain vs. snow), wind, cloud, humidity, pressure, and marine (waves, currents), a wind map, Feels like temperature by default, and home screen and lock screen widgets, all in one app.

Past hours are measured, not modelled. Where radar reaches (Europe, the United States and southern Canada), the rain behind you comes from observed radar, so a shower that fell at 14:00 sits at 14:00. Lock screen widgets keep the next hours in view without unlocking your phone.

Your own weather station: connect yours, or pick a station shared nearby straight from the map. Past hours at that place then show what the station measured, and the models are scored against those readings instead of the nearest grid point. Free, and your keys stay on the phone.

No login. No ads. No data collection. Just weather, verified.

- Commercial forecasts: add Apple Weather, OpenWeatherMap and Visual Crossing to the comparison, scored at your location against what actually happened

show_hn.title: Show HN: Weather app to show actual performance of weather models

quotes.text:
Got tired of forecasts being wrong and having no way to check. So I built an app that overlays what models predicted days ago vs. what actually happened, so you can literally see the accuracy on a timeline.

You can compare all open-meteo models (such as IFS, AIFS, AIGFS...) side by side. Choose how many days back you want to check (it uses open-meteo's Previous Model Runs API) and the app shows the previous prediction as a "ghost line" against observed data. There's also a scoring system that calculates an accuracy by temp, wind, rain and sun hours.

Features:
- Compares previous predictions vs. observed data
- Built-in scoring system that calculates accuracy by temp, wind, rain, and sun hours
- Separate storm accuracy page to choose the best model for predicting storms.
- Free and no ads!

Would love to hear what fellow weather nerds think. Any feedback is welcome!

If you're interested:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/verisky/id6759251875
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.verisky.app
